entries.symptom: JDK 17 not found, Unsupported class file major version, or Gradle requires JVM 17 or later
entries.cause: Gradle ran on another JDK (or none): JAVA_HOME unset or pointing at a different version
entries.fix: Select JDK 17 per process (the toolchain helper sets JAVA_HOME for the Gradle process); installing a JDK is a human step; never change the machine default (jenv global, update-alternatives, a shell profile export)

entries.symptom: SDK location not found. Define a valid SDK location with an ANDROID_HOME environment variable
entries.cause: ANDROID_HOME is unset in the Gradle process
entries.fix: Build through the build script, which passes ANDROID_HOME to every step; never write sdk.dir into the generated android/ folder

entries.symptom: Failed to install the following Android SDK packages ... (NDK) ... licences not accepted
entries.cause: The SDK licences were never accepted, so Gradle may not download the NDK or a platform
entries.fix: Human step: the developer runs sdkmanager --licenses in their own terminal once; never pipe yes into it from a script

entries.symptom: No version of NDK matched the requested version <x> (while offline)
entries.cause: The NDK the React Native template pins is downloaded on demand
entries.fix: Connect, or install that NDK version with the SDK Manager first

entries.symptom: Could not resolve all files for configuration ...
entries.cause: A Maven download failed (network, proxy or a repository outage)
entries.fix: Rerun once; behind a proxy set it in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties; never add repositories to the generated android/ folder
match: Could not resolve all files for configuration

entries.symptom: OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace in compileReleaseKotlin or lintVitalAnalyzeRelease
entries.cause: The Kotlin compiler ran inside the Gradle JVM (kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process) and filled its metaspace
entries.fix: Keep the Kotlin compiler out of process (the build skill passes it); raise org.gradle.jvmargs only through expo-build-properties or a plugin, after measuring

entries.symptom: Gradle daemon disappeared unexpectedly, or OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
entries.cause: The machine ran out of memory (several heavy builds at once)
entries.fix: Build one thing at a time with --no-daemon; never ./gradlew --stop, which stops other sessions' daemons

entries.symptom: A Gradle or manifest fix made in android/ (or in Android Studio) is gone after the next prebuild
entries.cause: android/ is generated by npx expo prebuild (Continuous Native Generation) and git-ignored
entries.fix: Put the setting in app.config.ts, expo-build-properties or a config plugin, then prebuild with --clean

entries.symptom: The emulator did not finish booting (x86_64 emulation currently requires hardware acceleration, CPU Architecture arm64 is not supported, Not enough space)
entries.cause: No hardware acceleration, a system image of another ABI, or a full disk
entries.fix: Read the emulator log: enable the hypervisor, use an image of the host's ABI, or free disk; then rerun

entries.symptom: Every emulator console port from 5554 to 5584 is taken
entries.cause: Sixteen emulators run on the machine, other sessions included
entries.fix: Stop only your own emulators (adb -s <serial> emu kill); never another session's, never adb kill-server

entries.symptom: adb: more than one device/emulator, or an adb command reached another session's emulator
entries.cause: adb ran without -s <serial> (or with -e / -d) while several devices were attached
entries.fix: Pass -s <serial> before every device command (the adbArgs helper); adb devices, adb version and adb start-server name no device and need none. Start emulators by AVD name

entries.symptom: The AVD boots to a "System UI isn't responding" dialog
entries.cause: A loaded machine during the first boot
entries.fix: Rerun when the load is lower; the ready signal times out instead of passing

entries.symptom: INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS
entries.cause: The APK holds no native libraries for the emulator image's ABI
entries.fix: Build for the image's ABI (the build script's --abi), or use an image of the host ABI

entries.symptom: INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE
entries.cause: An installed copy of the app is signed with another key
entries.fix: Uninstall it first (adb -s <serial> uninstall <package>); the fresh-install step does this

entries.symptom: INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NO_CERTIFICATES
entries.cause: An unsigned or re-zipped APK
entries.fix: Install the APK Gradle wrote, untouched

entries.symptom: INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK
entries.cause: The image's API level is below the app's minSdkVersion
entries.fix: Use an image at or above minSdk (the pinned image is API 36)

entries.symptom: Crash: couldn't find "lib<name>.so"
entries.cause: A library built for another ABI, or a dependency removed from package.json while JS still imports it
entries.fix: Rebuild for the emulator ABI; restore the dependency or remove the import, then prebuild with --clean

entries.symptom: The app process is not running, with no crash report
entries.cause: The app finished itself (a startup gate) or the system killed it
entries.fix: Read adb -s <serial> logcat -d -s ActivityManager ReactNativeJS AndroidRuntime

entries.symptom: A blank emulator screenshot: n% of the screen is #ffffff or #000000 (all white or black), or only the splash colour (rule blank-screen)
entries.cause: The JS crashed before the first frame, the screenshot ran before the app drew (still booting, lock screen), or the app never hid its splash because a startup gate waits
entries.fix: Read adb -s <serial> logcat -d -s ReactNativeJS:V AndroidRuntime:E (and -b crash), fix the crash, wait for the ready signal and screenshot again; a splash-colour screen goes to app-startup-and-bootstrap (the splash is released when startup ends)
match: of the screen is #[0-9a-fA-F]+: the app drew nothing

entries.symptom: Android screenshots show the reduced-motion app (no transitions, skipped celebrations)
entries.cause: Animations were disabled for stable screenshots (transition_animation_scale 0), and React Native and Reanimated read that as Reduce Motion
entries.fix: Leave the animation scales alone; wait for a still screen (two identical screenshots) instead

entries.symptom: emulator: ERROR: Running multiple emulators with the same AVD (is an experimental feature)
entries.cause: The AVD already runs: an earlier run kept it, or it is still booting or offline, so adb devices does not list it yet
entries.fix: Reuse it: find its serial with adb devices and adb -s <serial> emu avd name, or wait and rerun; never start a second copy, and never stop or wipe an AVD another project or session owns
match: Running multiple emulators with the same AVD

entries.symptom: adb: device offline (error: device offline) right after the emulator starts
entries.cause: adb lists the emulator before its adbd is up
entries.fix: Keep polling adb -s <serial> shell getprop sys.boot_completed until it prints 1 (it fails while the device is offline); reconnect only your own device (adb -s <serial> reconnect), never adb kill-server

entries.symptom: adbd cannot run as root in production builds (adb root fails on the emulator)
entries.cause: The AVD uses a Google Play system image (google_apis_playstore), which is a production build without adb root
entries.fix: Use a google_apis system image of the host ABI (the build skill pins one) for every check that needs adb root; keep Play images for Play Store flows only

entries.symptom: The built APK or AAB asks for a permission the app never requested (CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, a location permission)
entries.cause: A library adds it at manifest merge time
entries.fix: Block it with android.blockedPermissions (or the library option), or keep it, list it in the contract with its reason and declare it in Data safety

entries.symptom: A 16 KB page-alignment check fails (or the app crashes on a 16 KB-page device) while it works on most phones
entries.cause: A library ships native code linked for 4 KB pages; Google Play requires 16 KB support for apps that target Android 15 or newer
entries.fix: Update that library; never ship it

entries.symptom: A portrait-locked app rotates or resizes on a tablet or foldable running Android 16
entries.cause: For apps that target API 36, Android 16 ignores orientation, resizability and aspect-ratio restrictions on displays at least 600 dp wide
entries.fix: Lay out from the window size (useWindowDimensions, window classes) and test landscape on a tablet AVD; never rely on the orientation lock there

entries.symptom: The Android back gesture shows no preview animation, or a back handler stops firing after predictive back is enabled
entries.cause: Predictive back is opt-in (android.predictiveBackGestureEnabled, default false); once on, the system needs to know in advance whether the app handles back
entries.fix: Enable it deliberately in app.config.ts and test every screen that intercepts back (usePreventRemove, BackHandler) on an Android 14+ emulator

entries.symptom: Play refuses the upload: the bundle is signed with the wrong key (or keytool -printcert shows CN=Android Debug)
entries.cause: The release was built with another keystore (another machine, regenerated EAS credentials) or the signing properties are missing so Gradle fell back to the debug key
entries.fix: Stop: build with the registered upload key; if it is lost, the developer requests an upload key reset in Play Console. Never generate a new keystore for an app already on Play

entries.symptom: Keystore was tampered with, or password was incorrect; or Cannot recover key / Get Key failed at signReleaseBundle
entries.cause: A wrong password, or a separate key password: a PKCS12 keystore keeps one password and keytool ignored the second
entries.fix: Stop: the developer fixes the signing properties in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties (store and key password equal); never open the keystore or regenerate a registered key

entries.symptom: Play: Version code <n> has already been used
entries.cause: The versionCode was reused
entries.fix: Build again with the next number (EAS remote version source increments; the local lane takes the next ANDROID_VERSION_CODE); never lower it
match: Version code \d+ has already been used
